full_query: does a corneal abrasion usually cause discharge from the eye
sentences: A corneal abrasion typically does not cause significant discharge from the eye
The primary symptoms of a corneal abrasion include pain, a sensation of a foreign body in the eye, tearing, redness, and sensitivity to light
While mild discharge can occur due to increased tearing, it is not a prominent feature
If there is significant discharge, it may indicate a secondary infection or another underlying condition, such as conjunctivitis
